444→# ==================== Softmax + Cross-Entropy ====================
445→def softmax_cross_entropy_loss(
446→    logits: np.ndarray, y_true: np.ndarray
447→) -> tuple[float, np.ndarray]:
448→    """Softmax + 交叉熵损失
449→
450→    Parameters
451→    ----------
452→    logits : ndarray of shape (N, C)
453→        未归一化的输出
454→    y_true : ndarray of shape (N,)
455→        整数类别标签
456→
457→    Returns
458→    -------
459→    loss : float
460→    dlogits : ndarray of shape (N, C)
461→    """
462→    # 数值稳定 softmax
463→    shifted = logits - np.max(logits, axis=1, keepdims=True)
464→    exp_z = np.exp(shifted)
465→    probs = exp_z / np.sum(exp_z, axis=1, keepdims=True)
466→
467→    N = logits.shape[0]
468→    eps = 1e-12
469→    log_probs = np.log(np.clip(probs, eps, 1.0))
470→    loss = -np.sum(log_probs[np.arange(N), y_true]) / N
471→
472→    # 梯度
473→    dlogits = probs.copy()
474→    dlogits[np.arange(N), y_true] -= 1.0
475→    dlogits /= N
476→
477→    return float(loss), dlogits
